lines: {target}? Green stalks can hide quick trouble. I would help whoever is closest.
If anyone heads for Bamboo Jungle, tell them: Keep a path cut behind you. I will be at the square.
Bamboo crowds the eye and the feet. I will keep that in mind by the square.
Bamboo Jungle is no small story. A village survives by hands, not titles.
I will remember Bamboo Jungle as a green wall that rustles like whispers. I will keep my hands free to help.
